snippet.title: Dungeon Concierge Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Become an overworked wizard-janitor in this frenetic Dungeon Crawler where you clean instead of raiding. 

Complete contracts, master and upgrade your spells, create powerful synergies, and use the environment to dispatch foes without making a mess. All while surviving the corporate grind.
